title: The Child at the Edge of the Crowd

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: During a busy festival, a teenager notices a small child standing alone near the drums, looking around anxiously.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a busy festival, (name1), a teenager, notices a small child standing alone near the drums, looking around anxiously.

choices.label: Take the Child Somewhere Easy to See.
Ask a Drummer to Pause and Call Out.
Offer the Child a Fruit While Waiting.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child says their family went to get food, and the teenager waits with them until they return.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child is too shy to answer, so the teenager simply stays close until a parent appears.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A parent spots them from across the clearing and hurries over.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child refuses to move, so the teenager asks a friend to search instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family hears and comes running, relieved.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The sudden silence startles the child, but the family arrives soon after.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child eats happily, and the family returns shortly.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child is not hungry, but holding the fruit seems to help.
